items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-08-29
items.q: I got a call from a friend of mine by the name of Dorsey who was working for the Urban League at that time.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. It's a new day. It's a new day. Okay, where were we? Okay, so after, I mean after the Sentinel, where, what other, did you work for another paper after that?

No, I did not. What I did, I stayed in radio until 1962. And I got a call from a friend of mine by the name of Dorsey who was working for the Urban League at that time. Ebony Magazine had a position open, and for some reason Dorsey picked me over whomever at the time. And to make a long story short, I came back and I talked to my wife. And my wife said, well, find out what they're paying and so forth and so on. And after all, we're gonna have a family and we need a little extra money. So I said, well, I can keep…
